Naftal AI Platform

What it does

The assistant A question in French, an answer with its figures. The assistant runs the right queries, answers with the real numbers, and lists the data it read for that answer.
The scope Each employee sees their perimeter, nothing more. A district manager sees one district, a centre head one centre. A test suite proves it against the real database, even when someone tries to trick the AI.
The access A second code, and accounts an admin approves. A one-time code after the password, a lock after five wrong attempts, and new accounts that work only once an administrator sets their scope.
The reports Dashboards, analytics and PDF exports. Monthly deliveries, the service rate by centre, a knowledge base searched by meaning, and reports to download.

Try it yourself

  1. Sign in as com212 with any password, then the code 482913, shown on screen.
  2. Ask the assistant “Résume les livraisons de juin 2026 et explique la variation”. On the right: the data it read, and the centres outside your scope that it did not read.
  3. Sign out, then sign in as cdd208g: the figures shrink to one centre.
  4. Sign in as Admin to see the whole country and the admin panel.

My part

I built the platform as an internship project: the FastAPI backend, the permission model, the document search over local models, and the React interface.

The public demo replaces the backend with synthetic data that runs in your browser.

Built with

  • React
  • TypeScript
  • FastAPI
  • SQL Server, read-only
  • Ollama · Qwen 2.5
  • Qdrant
  • Python

The public demo uses entirely synthetic data: no Naftal data.
